PowerOptions was founded in 1998 and is New England’s largest not-for-profit energy-buying consortium. We help nonprofits and public entities lower energy costs, reduce carbon emissions, and handle a complex energy landscape. We serve more than 800 Members across Massachusetts, Maine, Rhode Island, and Connecticut. We work where energy markets, public purpose, and operational excellence meet, as a trusted energy advisor.

Job Overview

How Members experience their journey with PowerOptions, from first interest through renewal, decides whether they stay, grow, and trust us as a partner. PowerOptions is hiring a Lifecycle Operations Analyst. You will support the full Member journey and be the analytical backbone behind our lifecycle management, retention, and reporting work. This role is a good fit if you like complex data that covers many products, you think in processes and systems, and you enjoy working with teams to turn business needs into clear results.You will join our Member Relations team, which manages onboarding, renewal, and engagement for our public-sector and nonprofit Members. You will also work with all PowerOptions Functional Team Leads to find out what data and processes they need for their member-facing work and KPI reporting. Your work will directly affect how we attract, keep, and grow Members. It will also shape how much leadership can see about how Members experience and engage with PowerOptions.You will report to the Director of Member Relations.

Compensation and benefits: The salary range is $60,000–$65,000, based on experience. PowerOptions also offers a full benefits package, including health insurance, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

Job Responsibilities

Member journey and lifecycle optimization:

Map and measure key touchpoints across the Member lifecycle (nurturing, onboarding, engagement, renewal, win-back, and churn) for 800+ Members. Our services include energy supply, energy management, building decarbonization, compliance, distributed generation, clean transportation, and policy and regulatory support.
Monitor Member enrollment across products and services. Find gaps and overlaps, and recommend ways to broaden each Member’s portfolio.
Work with Functional Team Leads to find friction points and improve the Member journey, especially where Members use more than one offering at the same time.
Run the Member feedback cycle, including the systems that collect, track, and report on surveys and Net Promoter Scores.
Support key Member journey events, including onboarding, dues collection, and renewal.

Data Management In Salesforce

Support data integration and hygiene in Salesforce, including Member records, product and service enrollment, Membership status, and lifecycle stage fields.
Help maintain the data model that connects Members, accounts, opportunities, and contracts across all products and services.
Work with our Tech Enablement lead and consultants on data, workflow, and automation design.
Find and escalate data discrepancies between systems, and work with Member Managers, Tech Enablement, and vendor support to fix them.
Support user access, object configuration, and light administration as needed.

Reporting And Analytics

Build recurring and ad hoc reports and dashboards, mainly in Salesforce, that show Member leads, retention, renewal rates, engagement, and lifecycle performance by department, product, and Salesforce object.
Track KPIs across the Member journey (adoption, renewal, churn, cross-product engagement) and tell leadership about trends, risks, and opportunities.
Build a portfolio-level view that shows leadership which products drive retention and which need attention.
Work with Functional Team Leads to make sure reporting supports their decisions.
Improve reporting infrastructure to reduce manual work and give teams more self-serve access to insights.
Support the organization-wide KPI process by making sure data is available, tracked, and reported consistently.

What Success Looks Like

By month 6: Renewal, retention, and engagement reporting is accurate, documented, and available to Functional Team Leads without ad hoc requests.
By month 12: Member feedback runs on a set cycle. Results go to leadership, with a clear path from feedback to action.
Ongoing: Lifecycle stage and product enrollment data is complete and current for all Members.

Job Qualifications

What you bring:

Bachelor’s degree in business, data analytics, economics, or a related field, or equal practical experience
1–3 years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, membership, or marketing operations, ideally at a multi-product or multi-service organization
Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards, and administration (Administrator certification is a plus)
Strong Excel and spreadsheet skills
Comfort building reports and dashboards with segmented, multi-dimensional data
Experience developing and analyzing customer experience surveys
Strong attention to detail and a systems-thinking mindset. You notice when something does not add up across Members, accounts, and products.
A collaborative listener who turns team needs into action
A clear communicator who can turn data into recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
Comfort using AI to streamline workflows and automate routine work

Nice To Have

Working knowledge of SQL or another query language
Change management experience and comfort with complexity
Familiarity with the energy sector or nonprofit or public-sector environments

How To Apply

Send a cover letter, your current resume, and a link to your LinkedIn profile to jobs@poweroptions.org with the subject line “Lifecycle Operations Analyst.” Complete applications must include both a resume and a cover letter. We review applications on a rolling basis until we fill the position.

PowerOptions cannot sponsor employment visas at this time. PowerOptions participates in the federal E-Verify program. For more information, go to www.e-verify.gov.

Commitment to diversity: PowerOptions was founded to serve the needs of under-resourced communities and is a proud women-led nonprofit. We are committed to equity and inclusion in our work to promote energy justice and in our growth as an organization and industry leader. We want to build a diverse team with a wide range of perspectives, and to create opportunities for marginalized communities in the energy sector. PowerOptions is an equal opportunity employer. We hire, train, pay, and promote without regard to race, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic that makes each of us unique.

jobs.description:
PortfolioFuture is an independent fund discovery and intelligence company. We use empirical research to discover, evaluate, and rank ETFs and mutual funds, and identify where they can credibly compete for allocations in portfolios.

Our research connects more than 10,000 funds with institutional investors, 23,000+ advisory firms, and 400,000+ financial advisors, supporting fund discovery, portfolio analytics, and asset-manager distribution intelligence.

As an Investment Analyst
, you will research the portfolio managers, investment teams, and strategies behind the funds PortfolioFuture identifies. You will engage directly with portfolio managers, CIOs, and investment professionals to evaluate investment processes, understand sources of performance, and develop independent investment research.

What you’ll work on

Research ETF and mutual fund managers, investment teams, strategies, and investment processes.
Analyze portfolio construction, risk management, trading, and the sources of investment performance.
Prepare research questions using PortfolioFuture's quantitative findings and fund rankings.
Interview portfolio managers, CIOs, strategists, and investment teams to evaluate investment decisions and strategy differentiation.
Investigate performance persistence, portfolio changes, manager capabilities, and organizational developments.
Use large language models (LLMs) and AI to analyze investment materials, support manager due diligence, and organize research.
Produce clear written investment research, manager evaluations, and evidence-based conclusions.

What we’re looking for

Background in finance, economics, investment management, business, or a related field.
Strong interest in ETFs, mutual funds, portfolio management, and investment strategies.
Knowledge of portfolio construction, investment performance, risk, and active management.
Strong analytical judgment, research skills, and the ability to evaluate investment decisions critically.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence engaging with investment professionals.
Experience with manager research, due diligence, asset management, financial datasets, or AI research tools is a plus.

About PortfolioFuture

Fund Substitution identifies ETFs and mutual funds that can serve similar portfolio roles, using return similarity, relative performance, tracking error, and fees.

Fund Decomposition separates returns explained by investable market exposures from residual performance, evaluating replication quality, residual alpha, and risk.

Fund Opportunity ranks ETFs and mutual funds across four dimensions: Similar Fund Ranking, Addressable Market, Pure Alpha, and Diversification Benefits.

PortfolioFuture's research is independent. Commercial relationships do not affect which funds are surfaced, how they rank, or the conclusions reached.

With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Proficiency with software suites such as Microsoft 365, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
Ability to work fully onsite at DARPA's HQ in Arlington, VA.

Desired

At least 5 years of experience working with or for DARPA is highly desirable.
5+ years spent managing or leading a team of personnel performing complex technical or analytical projects is highly desirable.

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices.

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant.

About The Division

The Water Utilities Division is Mott MacDonald’s centre of excellence for responding to the UK and Ireland's water and wastewater challenges. The work we do is at the forefront of ensuring safe water supplies for future generations, preventing urban flooding, and improving the health of our rivers and coastal environments. Our multi-disciplinary teams provide a variety of services throughout the full project life cycle, from advisory services and feasibility studies to outline and detailed design. Together, we deliver best-in-class solutions to our clients while offering diverse and technically stimulating opportunities to our people.

Our clients include most UK water utility companies and many other governmental organisations and private companies in the UK and overseas. We cover all phases of the project lifecycle from feasibility studies through detailed design, construction support, and commissioning to handover.

Overview Of The Role

This role will focus on managing multidisciplinary water sector projects across the full project lifecycle, supporting delivery for major UK water company clients during AMP8. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering projects across areas such as water and wastewater treatment, storm overflows, and wider infrastructure programmes.

We work on a vast range of design projects covering, for example:
Water treatment
Water distribution and storage
Strom Overflow
SuDS
Wastewater drainage and recycling
Desalination

To help us to meet the growing needs of our clients, we have several positions for experienced technical project managers in water and wastewater who will thrive:
Leading the delivery of projects to time, cost, and quality, ensuring compliance with business management systems
Managing multidisciplinary teams, coordinating technical specialists across design and delivery stages
Acting as a key client interface, building strong and trusted relationships
Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks and opportunities
Overseeing commercial and contractual aspects including forecasting, programme control, and reporting
Supporting team development, providing guidance and mentoring to junior staff

This is great opportunity to make a difference. You have the skills, now use them at a company that values a different perspective. Being employee owned means we can choose our own direction and focus on what we believe is important for our clients, our people and the communities where we work and live.

Candidate specification

Essential:
Degree-qualified in engineering or a related discipline
Demonstrable project management experience delivering infrastructure projects in the water sector
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams across project lifecycle stages
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills
Ability to manage programme, cost, and water and wastewater engineering risks to achieve successful project outcomes
Proven ability to work independently and contribute to project success while guiding others

Desirable:
Chartered Engineer or working towards chartership
APM PMQ / MAPM or equivalent
Experience in AMP frameworks or UK water utilities programmes
Knowledge of CDM regulations and design management
Experience contributing to bids and proposals

UK Immigration

Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

Agile working

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion

We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone
feels they can contribute.

Accessibility

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:

Financial wellbeing

We match employee pension contributions between 4.5% and 7%.
Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury.
Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.

Employee Ownership

Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution.
Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.

Health and wellbeing

Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.

Lifestyle

A minimum of 33-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers.

Enhanced family and carers leave

Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.

Learning and development

Primary annual professional institution subscription.
A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options.

Networks, communities, and social outcomes

Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The Data Center Infrastructure Reliability and Quality (IRQ) Team owns the Quality and Reliability of critical infrastructure equipment for the lifecycle of equipment. This includes leading Design for Reliability (DFR) and Design for quality (DFQ) effort for AWS Infra New Product Development (NPD), supporting/sustaining the existing AWS critical infra equipment fleet by identifying systemic equipment issues, driving root cause analysis (RCA) corrective action to mitigate the risk in the AWS fleet.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for Quality and Reliability, you should be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally. You will lead multi-discipline and highly technical program teams. You should have experience of driving quality and reliability initiatives in a complex engineering environment and will have worked as a technical project manager on increasingly complex projects. Your experience includes data center infrastructure technologies including Electrical equipment such as Breakers, High, medium, low voltage equipment, Mechanical and Power Generation equipment. You will generate and maintain enhanced reporting, meaningful KPIs, and process/automation improvements to ensure team efficiency and visibility of the portfolio efforts to critical stakeholders and leadership.

You will partner with other engineering teams, purchasing team, external suppliers and project execution/delivery teams regularly. You will make strategic decisions regarding specific projects and overall program direction. You will be capable of connecting long-term strategies with rapid growth patterns of AWS, as well as guide specific operational needs of the business.

You must be adept at identifying and communicating upcoming risks, issues, and bottlenecks as well as be instrumental in resolving those issues, often cross multiple departmental boundaries to achieve your goal. Amazon Web Services Open Data Analytics (ODA) organization is looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive cross-team programs spanning release infrastructure, query engine development, and datalake integrations across Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena.

ODA powers millions of clusters across all AWS regions, enabling customers to run massive-scale analytics using open-source frameworks like Apache Spark, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Hudi, and Delta. Our teams build the automated release pipelines that package and distribute production-ready releases across multiple deployment modes (EC2, EKS, Serverless), and develop the core query engine optimizations that deliver 5x+ performance improvements over open-source baselines.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to coordinate complex, cross-cutting programs across our Release Automation (Fundamentals) and Engines teams. Build and maintain integrated program schedules across the Fundamentals and Engines teams, tracking milestones, dependencies, and critical path items across release pipeline modernization, region expansion, and engine optimization workstreams.

Identify, assess, and mitigate risks that span team boundaries — escalating early when release pipeline issues threaten downstream engine delivery or when upstream open-source changes impact release timelines.

Drive region build programs end-to-end, coordinating infrastructure readiness, release validation, and service launch activities across multiple AWS regions and deployment modes (EC2, EKS, Serverless).

The Senior Program Manager will serve as the primary point of accountability to the Government

.

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader and integrator

Program Leadership & Strategy

Develop and execute comprehensive program strategies, governance frameworks, and performance management processes.
Lead Agile and incremental delivery, balancing MVP-focused development, sprint-based execution, evolving requirements, and long-term program objectives.

Ensure program objectives, contractual commitments, and mission requirements are consistently met.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

Build and maintain relationships across multiple levels of Government, from technical and working-level stakeholders through senior executive leadership.
Establish strong customer relationships and maintain accountability for customer satisfaction and mission outcomes.

Balance customer needs, contractual requirements, technical considerations, risk, cost, and program objectives.

Technical & Delivery Oversight

We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.

The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.  We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at:  peopleone@slalom.com . Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.

new_jobs.description:
Description

SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER, TECHNOLOGIES

This TRAVEL position is based out of a national project site.

About ArchKey

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project.This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

About The Position

Responsible to manage one large project or multiple technology projects of varying sizes and complexities from start to finish, including estimating, contract negotiations, project design, technical direction, quality control, job scheduling, financial oversight, problem resolution, job completion, coordination, communication, client satisfaction activities and other related duties. This position manages a team of project management employees and has responsibility for business development, project budgets, projections and contracts, job solicitation and project negotiations, in alignment with all Company policies, procedures, key objectives and regulations.This position may assist technologies construction projects including but not limited to all types of low voltage systems such as voice/data, video and security systems, audiovisual, nurse call, distributed antenna systems, and fire alarm systems.

Our Ideal Candidate

Puts a strong emphasis on candidate experience.
Can flex and adapt with the growing needs of the business.
Has extensive experience managing technology construction projects.
Can adhere to the travel nature of the role.

Day in the Life

Partners with leadership to provide strategic input to key objectives and decisions affecting the business unit and functional work group. Conducts high-quality business development and job solicitation in the marketplace, in partnership with other Company leaders. Provides ongoing quality reviews and project communication with owners, contractors, designers, subcontractors, engineers, architects, field staff, and other customers or stakeholders, addressing and resolving issues when needed.
Directs all phases and activities of each project to achieve high quality and productivity in the work performed. This includes bidding, budgeting, monitoring projections, and establishing goals and standards of performance. Ensures all jobs or contracts are fulfilled to the customer’s satisfaction, and the Company earns a fair profit. Optimizes efficiency of labor, materials, supplies, equipment, and tools, and ensures all plans and specifications clearly identify project scope and milestones, are shared with the appropriate parties, and adhere to approved budgets. Ensures all safety programs and OSHA requirements are followed.
Communicates directly with subcontractors and designers concerning project costs, staffing, and scheduling. Prepares and manages timely and accurate project documents, estimates, projections, material release schedules, client information, project schedules, purchase orders, monthly invoices, payments, closeout documents, warranties, drawings, maintenance manuals, final billings, change orders, cost codes and other documentation to support construction project work.
Procures materials proactively and coordinated, working with the purchasing team to reduce material price fluctuations. May negotiate with vendors and distributors on availability and pricing of materials, completion of quotes, and other necessary procedure details. Ensures all plans and submittals are thoroughly and accurately reviewed for content and conformance with the construction documents and maintained in the appropriate systems.
others to transfer documentation, schedules, and other information.
Provides day-to-day direction to project foreman and/or superintendent to monitor productivity goals and build teamwork. Partners with appropriate personnel to conduct job site inspections and ensure accurate scope, placement, and conformance with the contract documents and the Company’s project quality assurance standards. Ensures all field personnel have the current materials, tools, plans, schedules, and directions needed for work, and that all changes in budget and scope of work are communicated and documented appropriately.
Provides high-quality hiring, coaching, communications, training, mentoring, and team building to staff and other co-workers as needed. Provides performance feedback regularly. Addresses people's issues as they arise and involves the necessary resources to resolve problems.
Creates and manages an annual financial budget and maintains some level of responsibility for Companywide financials. Stays informed of new and changing Company procedures, policies, materials, technologies, techniques, and practices. Establishes, trains, and maintains policies and processes as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in electrical, project management, construction management, or a related field.
Minimum 5-7 years of project management experience. Extensive project management training and skills. Thorough understanding of the project life cycle.
Experience with computerized estimating systems and software, preferably Accubid. Experience and proficiency using Accubid, Revit, CAD, SKM, AGI, Navisworks, and/or BIM systems may be required for some divisions or business groups.
Trained and proficient in project management tools and techniques, negotiating, budgeting, estimating, costing, contracting, scheduling, pricing, and common code requirements. Strong business analysis and mathematical skills. Show ability to diagnose complex problems with strategic critical thinking skills and detail orientation, and to drive appropriate solutions with self-initiative and sensitivity.
Knowledge of and proficiency with construction methods and materials, costing, power, lighting, systems design, and general industry safety and OSHA standards, procedures, and regulations. Keen understanding of the National Electric Code. Skills to read, interpret and understand financial documents, electrical bids, contracts, plans, drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
Excellent communicator/collaborator, with the ability to clearly and concisely articulate ideas and concepts and the ability to build strong working teams, cultures, and relationships at all levels and with customers, subcontractors, vendors, and other community leaders. Strong business development, documentation, and report preparation skills.
Strong hiring, collaboration, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work with and facilitate diverse work teams. Leadership, customer focus, delegation, and decision-making skills. Working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements.

Travel

Travel to project sites is required, which may include temporary relocation for the duration of the project.

Salary Range

$107,000-$145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits

At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com.

Legal & Fraud Disclaimer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.Weare an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer.

Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. To confirm the legitimacy of a job, visit our careers page or reach out to a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

new_jobs.title: Loss Prevention Investigations Manager
new_jobs.description:
TJX Canada

At TJX Canada, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—WINNERS, HomeSense, and Marshalls, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer. Here at TJX Canada, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to the inclusion and accommodation of all individuals.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Loss Prevention Investigations Manager - Internal
to lead our Internal Investigations team across Western Canada
and drive strategies that reduce loss, deter internal theft and fraud, and support the achievement of our broader Loss Prevention objectives. In this highly visible leadership role, you'll partner with cross-functional leaders and team members across the business, building strong relationships that influence decision-making and drive meaningful results throughout the region. You'll have the opportunity to lead a team, shape investigative programs, and champion a culture of integrity, collaboration, and accountability. If you're a strategic leader who thrives on solving complex challenges, developing talent, and making a measurable business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Work With Us?

We value integrity, respect, and collaboration, encouraging a unique and inclusive culture.
Immediate access to our Group Benefits package, including a Health Care Spending Account, Associate & Family Assistance Program, and various well-being resources
Management Incentive Plan along with a robust Retirement Savings Program
A competitive vacation package, paired with a Vacation Trade Program that allows you to opt in for an extra week.
Enjoy Associate discounts at our stores, available to you and eligible family members.
Comprehensive training and development resources designed to help you learn, grow, and succeed.
Exciting career paths with growth opportunities and tuition reimbursement to support your career progression.

What You’ll Do

Drive the execution of the internal investigations' strategy, ensuring alignment with Loss Prevention objectives while proactively seeing opportunities to reduce shrink, theft, and fraud.
Develop and enhance investigation procedures, leverage analytics and important metrics to identify trends, prioritize effectively, and implement continuous improvements across the function.
Collaborate closely with Store Operations, Human Resources, Analytics, Compliance, Technology, and Loss Prevention teams to support investigations, share insights, and drive effective business outcomes.
Supervise emerging trends, recommend innovative solutions, lead special projects, and support the successful implementation of policy and procedural changes.
Coach, mentor, and develop team members through talent planning, performance management, and development initiatives, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and operational excellence.

About You

Post-secondary education in a related field preferred, combined with 5-7 years of dynamic leadership experience in retail, ideally within Loss Prevention, Investigations, Operations, or an off-price retail environment.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Open Data Analytics Engines
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services Open Data Analytics (ODA) organization is looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive cross-team programs spanning release infrastructure, query engine development, and datalake integrations across Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena.

ODA powers millions of clusters across all AWS regions, enabling customers to run massive-scale analytics using open-source frameworks like Apache Spark, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Hudi, and Delta. Our teams build the automated release pipelines that package and distribute production-ready releases across multiple deployment modes (EC2, EKS, Serverless), and develop the core query engine optimizations that deliver 5x+ performance improvements over open-source baselines.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to coordinate complex, cross-cutting programs across our Release Automation (Fundamentals) and Engines teams. You will drive end-to-end delivery of programs that span release pipeline modernization, engine performance initiatives, open-source upstream integrations, and region expansion. You will manage dependencies across teams, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure that our engineering investments translate into measurable customer outcomes.

Key job responsibilities

Own and drive cross-team program execution for release automation, engine performance, and datalake integration initiatives spanning Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena.

Build and maintain integrated program schedules across the Fundamentals and Engines teams, tracking milestones, dependencies, and critical path items across release pipeline modernization, region expansion, and engine optimization workstreams.

Identify, assess, and mitigate risks that span team boundaries — escalating early when release pipeline issues threaten downstream engine delivery or when upstream open-source changes impact release timelines.

Define program metrics and mechanisms (WBRs, dashboards, program reviews) to measure release velocity, pipeline reliability, engine performance benchmarks, and operational toil reduction.

Drive region build programs end-to-end, coordinating infrastructure readiness, release validation, and service launch activities across multiple AWS regions and deployment modes (EC2, EKS, Serverless).

Coordinate open-source integration programs, ensuring that upstream contributions to Apache Spark, Trino, and Apache Iceberg are tracked, reviewed, and merged in alignment with internal release cadences.

Partner with engineering leaders to facilitate technical trade-off discussions, helping teams balance new capability development against reliability, security patching, and operational debt reduction.

Author and deliver written narratives (OP documents, business reviews, program status updates) to communicate progress, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership.

Drive continuous improvement in release processes by identifying bottlenecks, proposing automation opportunities, and establishing mechanisms that prevent recurring issues.

A day in the life

The Open Data Analytics (ODA) organization builds and operates the services that millions of AWS customers rely on for large-scale data processing — Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena. Our teams enable customers to run analytics using open-source frameworks like Apache Spark, Trino, Hive, and datalake table formats like Apache Iceberg, Hudi, and Delta, across multiple deployment modes and every AWS region.

This TPM role sits at the intersection of two critical teams within ODA:

ODA Fundamentals owns the end-to-end release lifecycle — the automated pipelines (Kamino) that take open-source frameworks and package them into production-ready AMIs and container images, the patching and region build programs, and the release automation tooling that ensures every release reaches customers reliably.

ODA Engines owns the core query engine and datalake integrations — making deep modifications to Spark, Trino, and Iceberg to deliver superior performance, scalability, and enterprise features in serverless environments. This team actively contributes to open-source communities and stays current with the latest framework versions.

Our culture values operational excellence, technical depth, and builder empowerment. We believe that great program management makes engineering teams faster — not by adding process, but by removing ambiguity, surfacing risks early, and creating mechanisms that let engineers focus on building. We are a team that ships frequently, operates what we build, and takes pride in the infrastructure that powers analytics at AWS scale.

About The Team

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Technical Program Manager drives the at-scale global implementation of the newest generations of data center electrical products and electrical distribution infrastructure technologies from concept through deployment. Just as critically, the TPM is the drum beat for product engineering and design and for New Product Introduction (NPI) into at-scale manufacturing facilities — synchronizing engineering, design, qualification, and manufacturing readiness so products transition smoothly from development into high-volume global production. This role provides a unique opportunity to engage with advanced infrastructure solutions and the exceptional people that develop them. Electrical Products and Services (EPS) within AWS Data Center Engineering designs, qualifies, manufactures, and deploys the standardized electrical products that distribute power throughout our data centers at hyperscale. Our team owns the low-voltage power distribution path from the electrical room to the rack. We productize this infrastructure to standardize and optimize power distribution package, automation, and footprint, qualify it with our suppliers, introduce it into at-scale manufacturing, , and deploy and sustain it across the global fleet (AMER, EMEA, and APAC), driving continuous generational improvements in cost, capacity, and reliability along the way.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These technologies are essential for meeting our customers' expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon's goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers at hyper-scale speed. We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in data center technology. You should be comfortable driving execution in a fast-paced and often uncertain environment, and delivering results, while demonstrating leadership, technical competence, and a bias for action.

As An Ideal Candidate, You

Are passionate about understanding customers' and stakeholders' needs
Have passion for program delivery, infrastructure execution, and low voltage products
Are great at solving problems and removing blockers
Have the ability to manage multiple programs/projects at different stages while staying organized
Earn trust and build relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Product Development, Finance, Operations)
Are comfortable addressing and resolving ambiguity
Recognize and appreciate diversity of thought and perspectives

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, product development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex technology programs. You prioritize your activities to keep programs on track, identify and resolve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for delivery success.

This role requires travel of 20%+ to manufacturing facilities, AWS engineering hubs, data center sites, and supplier locations to drive NPI, qualification, and at-scale deployment.

We have an immediate opening for a Sr. Technical Program Manager in Northern Virginia, Austin, and Columbus. Seattle is a fourth and less-preferred option. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale size, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities

Lead the cross-functional programs that design, develop, launch, and support LV power distribution, monitoring, and switching products (e.g. UL891) with $1B+ USD annual production, owning the end-to-end schedule, scope, and execution.
Set the cadence for product engineering and design teams, driving NPI milestones and introduction into at-scale manufacturing facilities, and ensuring manufacturing readiness, qualification, and ramp targets are met.
Engage with internal and external teams and partners to align program requirements, dependencies, and delivery commitments against rack and DC design roadmaps.
Build detailed program plans, defining milestones, deliverables, and success criteria across engineering, qualification, and deployment workstreams.
Coordinate between multiple teams to manage interdependencies, sequence critical path work, and secure the budget and resources required to execute product roadmaps on time.
Identify, communicate, and mitigate program risks and blockers, and report technical status, trade-offs, and escalations to Sr. Management.
Own and drive the complete delivery lifecycle from program kickoff through implementation, wide-scale deployment, and eventual deprecation, ensuring quality and operational readiness at each phase.
Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist.

About The Team

*Why AWS*

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated professional track record in Product Development, Data Center/ Mission-Critical Facilities (Design, Operation, Planning), or Low Voltage Power Distribution products.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

EverPro,
a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

Project development

Remote US

Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate Vice President, Facilities - Project Manager focused on tenant improvements to lead the planning, design, construction, and delivery of Ares’ corporate office buildouts throughout the United States, while supporting select international projects and project management across other strategic initiatives as needed.

This role will be responsible for managing a large portfolio of tenant improvement projects, office expansions, densifications, relocations, office upgrades, acquisition-related integrations, and space reduction and decommission initiatives. The successful candidate will serve as the primary project management lead across the project lifecycle, ensuring delivery of projects on schedule, within budget, and aligned with Ares' evolving workplace standards and business objectives.

The position requires a strategic thinker with strong construction management expertise, financial acumen, contract negotiation experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively and efficiently with stakeholders across multiple business functions. This individual will partner closely with executive leadership, regional facilities teams, external consultants, landlords, architects, contractors, and vendors to ensure successful execution of projects and seamless transition to ongoing operations.

Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead all phases of tenant improvement and capital projects across Ares' U.S. office portfolio, including planning, programming, design, budgeting, construction, commissioning, occupancy, and closeout.
Manage multiple concurrent projects ranging from office expansions and relocations to densifications, renovations, workplace upgrades, and acquisition-driven integrations.
Develop comprehensive project schedules, milestones, risk registers, and delivery plans to ensure successful execution.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to define business requirements, workplace standards, and operational objectives.
Conduct regular site visits and travel extensively to oversee project execution, mitigate risks, and ensure quality outcomes.
Maintain flexibility across project load to enable prioritization of critical deadlines and deliverables within a changing and growing workplace environment.
Provide executive-level reporting regarding project status, budget performance, key risks, and mitigation strategies.

Design & Construction Management

Manage external architects, engineers, project managers, furniture vendors, consultants, contractors, and specialty vendors throughout the project lifecycle.
Understand and align with lease requirements, permitting, landlord approvals, and construction administration and Tenant Improvement reimbursement processes.
Ensure projects align with corporate design standards (architectural, security and technological) and coordinate with the Ares technology team around implementation of Ares technology standards.
Review construction documents, schedules, change orders, and contractor submissions to maintain project quality and consistency.
Drive continuous improvement of workplace design standards, construction processes, and project delivery methodologies.

Capital Planning & Financial Management

Manage the annual Facilities Capital Expenditure (CapEx) budget across all active and upcoming projects.
Develop more robust financial forecasting, budget tracking, reporting, and project performance dashboards for leadership review.
Monitor project budgets throughout design and construction phases to identify and mitigate variances.
Prepare business cases, financial analyses, and leadership presentations supporting capital investment decisions.
Manage all Tenant Improvement refund processes to completion and in alignment with lease requirements.

Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Management

Lead RFP development, bid evaluations, vendor selection processes, and contract negotiations for design, construction, furniture, and workplace service providers.
Manage consultant and contractor agreements, ensuring favorable commercial terms and compliance with company standards.
Oversee purchase order creation, invoice management, budget allocation, and project-related payment approvals and payment processing through Ares’ billing portal.
Partner closely with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure efficient project execution and financial controls.
Build strategic relationships with preferred vendors while driving consistency and economies of scale across the portfolio.

Stakeholder & Change Management

Partner with the Global Head of Facilities and senior business leaders to align projects with growth plans, headcount forecasts, and operational requirements.
Facilitate workplace design reviews and decision-making meetings with stakeholders across business functions.
Develop communication strategies that provide transparency regarding project scope, schedule, milestones, risks, and impacts.
Support change management efforts associated with relocations, expansions, consolidations, and acquisition-related integrations.

Operational Transition & Portfolio Support

Ensure complete and seamless transition of newly delivered projects to Regional Facilities Managers and operational teams.
Develop turnover documentation, operating procedures, warranty tracking, and maintenance requirements.
Capture lessons learned and establish best practices across the global facilities project portfolio.
Support select international projects and global process-improvement initiatives as organizational priorities evolve.

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required.
Project Management degree or certificate (or work experience equivalent).
Expertise reading construction documents required.
Expertise in Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project (or other schedule management tool)
Bluebeam, CAD or other plans review tool experience preferred.
Architectural or construction project management background preferred.
Experience with large-scale Capex projects and budget tracking required.
Experience with Coupa (or similar billing/procurement software) preferred.

Head of Global Facilities

$100,000 - $120,000

new_jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance:
Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT
, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power:
Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data:
Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET
, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education
: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution
: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About Holepunch

At Holepunch, we're building a peer-to-peer platform for apps that don't need servers at all. Users connect directly, which means they keep full control of their data and their conversations stay private by design. We believe the internet should be peer-to-peer by default, and Keet, our P2P video call and chat app, is how we're showing the world what that looks like.

Keet runs on Pear Runtime and our open-source stack (Hypercore, Hyperswarm, Hyperdrive), which handles everything from peer discovery and NAT traversal to data replication and end-to-end encryption.

About The Job

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager
to help keep that work moving.

You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases. This is a great role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into technical project or product management in a deeply technical, open-source environment.

Responsibilities

Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current
Run or support stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives across time zones (mostly async)
Coordinate between the engine team, Keet app/UI developers, and QA so dependencies are visible early
Write clear status updates, release notes, and meeting summaries
Help triage bug reports and user feedback, and route them to the right engineers
Spot risks and blockers early and help the team resolve them
Keep internal documentation and processes tidy and easy to follow

Mandatory:

1–2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role (internships and open-source involvement count)
Excellent written English communication; you can explain technical progress clearly and concisely
Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through
Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly
Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)
Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:

Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)
Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes
Some exposure to JavaScript/Node.js or experience working alongside a dev team
Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software
Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)
Experience working across many time zones

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The CDW Project Manager is a trusted consultant, providing project management expertise across multiple technology stacks and services. Projects are typically of low to medium complexity and incorporate mainstream, legacy and emerging technologies. The Project Manager may independently manage projects, or work within a large program under the guidance of Program Managers. The successful candidate balances scope, schedules, budget and understands how to leverage PMO tools and templates to drive successful business outcomes for the customer. This position works with mixed teams consisting of CDW engineers, CDW sales, other members of CDW cross functional business areas, customer staff, and third-party consultants. The CDW Project Manager is a project advocate and relationship builder. They drive successful engagements through negotiation, concise communication, crucial conversations, and leadership abilities.

What You Will Do

Use experience, skillset, and methodologies to understand the client’s end goals and provide a consultative approach to ensure that the solution provided is appropriate for the client’s desired overall outcome and strategy.
Be a trusted consultant to your project team in all matters related to project delivery, CDW processes, and project management with best practices and delivery. Build relationships with all project stakeholders.
Creates and maintains presence with all project stakeholders, acting as a CDW steward for quality. Dedicated to meeting or exceeding stakeholder expectations. Identifies success criteria and ensures that it is met by involving the stakeholders in key decisions and linking project outcomes to strategic business initiatives.
Recognizes the need for negotiations, gathers relevant information, and seeks advice from sales and management when needed. Negotiates changes (cost, scope, effort, schedule of solution, resource commitment, etc.) to agreeable results. Effective negotiation of changes that achieve stakeholder satisfaction and drive positive project results.
Works with team members to gather information and determine impacts to the project, document mitigation steps taken in troubleshooting, and communicate these to the team and client.
Independently manages medium to large sized projects requiring complex cross functional collaboration and management, adhering to CDW’s project management processes and methodologies.
Accountable for project profitability. Track project budgets and resources and manage actuals vs. planned hours against the resource allocation and budget. Timely reporting of project financials and budgets to stakeholders. Ties project outcomes to clients’ business strategies, helping to generate new business.
Ensures that time, expenses, and invoices are accurately tracked and approved against the project in a timely manner.
Validates initial project scope and estimates. Determine the need for a new Statement of Work versus a Change Order. Makes sellers aware of new opportunities for additional services opportunities uncovered during project delivery.
Ensures all items defined in CDW Statement of Work are delivered and perform quality assurance throughout the lifecycle of the project.
Establishes, monitors, adjusts and communicates tasks and associated schedules to the project team and modifies when necessary. Build project schedules in conjunction with our engineering teams and partner resources.
Aids in identifying proper resources and optimizing billable schedules, monitors and adjusts assignments as necessary to drive client satisfaction and project profitability.
Identify, documents, tracks, and communicate project risks and issues. Strategizes potential resolution and drives desired course of action to bring issues to timely resolution.
Manages equipment, software, licensing and outside services procurement and delivery schedules.
Documents, outcomes, lessons learned and shared appropriately with colleagues. Leverage expertise to help drive business process improvements within the CDW Services PMO.
Take accountability for project results and hold all project team members accountable for their scope of work and schedule commitments. Is fiscally responsible to the client, the project and to CDW.
Instills trust with our clients by building strong relationships with stakeholders.
Uses political savviness, business acumen, and relevant personnel along with CDW experience to establish credibility.
Demonstrates the ability to diffuse uncomfortable situations with client and/or project team.
Leads teams to consistently meet project success factors and exceed client expectations.
Inspects delegated tasks to ensure timely and accurate completion. Coach and mentor Associate Project Managers.
Stays abreast of industry best practices through research, conferences, training seminars and participation in professional associations. Shares information across the Services PMO.
Determines the appropriate documentation (communication plans, schedules/timelines, status reports, quality plan, closure summary, budget, risk plan, etc.) for projects. Manages the quality and delivery of documentation to clients.
Has a clear and concise communication style, leads and facilitates both live and virtual meetings. Keeps meetings on track, on topic and summarizes, assigns and publishes follow up items in a timely manner.
Adapts communication style and medium to the audience's needs. Recognizes when communication efforts are ineffective and adapts tactics and/or medium as necessary.
Effectively prepares and delivers difficult information. Can credibly communicate complex topics to stakeholders and build consensus.
Anticipates client or project needs, communicates potential solutions. Conveys CDW experiences and positive outcomes to build client confidence and trust.
Develop and manage a detailed schedule and work plan.

What We Expect From You

Bachelor’s Degree and 4 years of experience in project management or four years of CDW Services experience OR 8 years of experience in project management or 8 years of CDW Services experience
Two or more years of experience in leading small to medium scale projects in a professional services organization.
Project management or agile consulting experience as it pertains to advising clients of delivery best practices across multiple technology stacks (e.g., Cloud, Security, Infrastructure)
Ability to support presales activities and look for new sales opportunities to help the client achieve organizational goals while growing CDW’s portfolio of work.
Participate productively in virtual teams in order to improve Project Management processes.
Experience Project Managing projects with several technologies.
Demonstrated ability to take accountability for projects and their results, be fiscally responsible and lead teams to meet project success factors.
Working knowledge of one or more formal project management methodologies, proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Project/Office.
Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills including demonstrated experience presenting technology recommendations from a business perspective.
Applies discretion when dealing with sensitive/confidential information.
Ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously and adapt to the changing needs of the business while meeting deadlines.
Ability to work weekends and/or off hours as necessary to meet clients' needs.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% or as needed to other CDW locations, meetings and client sites.
Ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information. Ability to organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology. Ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize. Ability to apply common sense in performing job. Ability to understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines.
PMP and/or Agile Certification(s), a plus
Experience using both Waterfall and Agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) to manage projects, a plus
Pay range: $77,725 - $108,265 depending on experience and skill set Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan Benefits overview: https://cdw.benefit-info.com/ Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

CDW is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by state and local law.
